before: The automation pagination provider laid out a live view with reuseAcrossRevisions defaulting to true, then disposed the session.
after: The provider lays out with reuseAcrossRevisions: false, so the session drops its paragraph break cache and construction state after the one layout. Page numbers and the page count are the same.
reason: Only the provider's export session cache retention changes. The measured layout, the field results it feeds, and every shared field, operation, node identity, snapshot, and awareness payload are unchanged.
